key_concepts: Electricity is a form of energy and lightning is an example of static electricity
Atoms contain positively charged protons, uncharged neutrons, and negatively charged elect
Conductors allow charge and heat to move easily, insulators do not, and semiconductors are
Electric charge is measured in coulombs, current in amperes, and power in watts
Protons carry positive charge, electrons carry negative charge, and neutrons are neutral
Like charges repel and unlike charges attract
Neutral materials contain equal numbers of positive and negative charges
Charging means gaining or losing electrons
Charging by friction transfers electrons between two rubbed materials
Electron affinity describes how strongly a material attracts electrons
The elementary charge is 1.6 x 10^-19 coulomb
Charges are neither created nor destroyed but only transferred
